title: MCP server entry
description: One server object under 'mcpServers' in the 'mcp' state document. Only remote HTTP transport is supported.

url.description: Remote HTTP(S) endpoint URL. May contain ${ENV_VAR} templates resolved at load time.

endpoint.description: Legacy alias for 'url'. Prefer 'url' for new entries; both are accepted at load time.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers (e.g. Authorization). Values may contain ${ENV_VAR} templates.
